name_zh: 塔吉克·鲁达基：波斯诗歌之父与宫廷语言
name_en: Tajik Rudaki: Father of Persian Poetry & Court Language
description_zh: 鲁达基 (约858-941) 被誉为波斯诗歌之父，萨曼王朝宫廷诗人，确立了新波斯语诗歌格律与主题，将阿拉伯字母书写的新波斯语确立为宫廷行政与文学语言，为后世菲尔多西、哈菲兹、萨迪奠基。
description_en: Rudaki (c.858-941) hailed as father of Persian poetry, Samanid court poet, established New Persian poetry meter and themes, established Arabic-script New Persian as court administrative and literary language, laid foundation for later Ferdowsi, Hafez, Sadi.
reason_zh: 鲁达基代表伊斯兰黄金时代波斯语文学复兴的奠基者，展示了被阿拉伯化征服的波斯文化如何通过诗歌语言重建民族认同，是整个波斯语文化圈的共同始祖。
reason_en: Rudaki represents Islamic Golden Age Persian literary revival founder, demonstrating how Persian culture Arabized conquest rebuilt national identity through poetic language, the common ancestor of entire Persianate cultural sphere.
steps_zh: 研究鲁达基早年生活与萨曼王朝布哈拉宫廷环境
分析鲁达基确立新波斯语诗歌格律(马斯纳维、加扎勒、鲁拜)
探讨鲁达基将新波斯语从口语推向宫廷行政书面语
评估鲁达基失明后口述创作与《鲁达基诗集》编纂
总结鲁达基对菲尔多西《列王纪》、哈菲兹抒情诗的奠基影响
steps_en: Study Rudaki early life and Samanid Bukhara court environment
Analyze Rudaki establishing New Persian poetry meters (masnavi, ghazal, rubai)
Explore Rudaki elevating New Persian from vernacular to court administrative written language
Evaluate Rudaki blind oral composition and Diwan compilation
Summarize Rudaki foundational influence on Ferdowsi Shahnameh and Hafez lyric poetry
expected_zh: 掌握鲁达基波斯语诗歌格律奠基与宫廷语言确立双重使命，理解被征服文化如何通过语言艺术实现精神解放，评估其对中亚波斯语文明千年传承的决定性贡献。
expected_en: Master Rudaki Persian poetry meter foundation and court language establishment dual mission, understand how conquered culture achieves spiritual liberation through language art, evaluate its decisive contribution to millennium Persianate civilization transmission.
case_zh: 约858 鲁达基生于潘吉肯特；900s 萨曼宫廷诗人；941 逝世。波斯诗歌之父宫廷语言范式永存。
case_en: c.858 Rudaki born in Panjakent; 900s Samanid court poet; 941 death. Father of Persian poetry court language paradigm endures.
cross_cultural_impact: Persian poetry meter founder; court language; Ferdowsi/Hafez ancestor
artistic_legacy: 是: 古典波斯诗歌/格律奠基
